entries.name: libtracepoint_rt_iosmac.metallib
entries.role: GPU developer tooling or paravirtual GPU support
entries.note: GPU debugger/replay/compiler or VM paravirtual graphics; BifrOSt has no GPU capture/replay tool; not needed for users, build only if GPU debugging is wanted. role inferred from the owning framework path; the metallib was not disassembled

entries.name: libtracepoint_rt_osx.metallib
entries.role: GPU developer tooling or paravirtual GPU support
entries.note: BifrOSt ships no GPU developer capture tools or paravirtual GPU driver, which are the only users of this shader.

entries.name: KeynoteMetalLibrary.metallib
entries.role: Effects shader of TSReading (app or system UI animation)
entries.note: TSReading UI effect shader (animations, gradients, glows); BifrOSt apps draw their own UI with the shape/glass pipeline and have no equivalent per-effect shader. role inferred from the owning framework path; the metallib was not disassembled
